title: JaRS: Contrast-Free Localization of Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Jacobian Row Sums
abstract: arXiv:2611.18024v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models sometimes memorize and reproduce regions of their training images, raising privacy and copyright concerns. We aim to localize these regions. Existing contrast-based methods use the diagonal of the denoiser Jacobian, which reflects the posterior variance of each pixel. However, a small diagonal entry is ambiguous: it signals either memorization or averaging over many neighboring pixels in smooth or predictable regions. To resolve this ambiguity, these methods subtract a reference map, which requires a second evaluation with a null prompt or an earlier checkpoint. Unconditional models have no null prompt, and earlier checkpoints are unavailable in general. We show that Jacobian row sums (JaRS), unlike the diagonal, separate memorization from local averaging without a reference map. Pairing JaRS with an image-level detection score that uses the same statistic at an early denoising step yields JaRS+. Across Stable Diffusio

translated_title: JaRS：基于雅可比行和的扩散模型记忆区域无对比定位方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型有时会记忆并复现其训练图像中的部分区域，这引发了隐私和版权方面的担忧。我们的目标是定位这些区域。现有的基于对比的方法使用去噪器雅可比矩阵的对角线，它反映了每个像素的后验方差。然而，较小的对角线元素存在歧义：它既可能表示记忆效应，也可能表示在平滑或可预测区域中对许多相邻像素进行了求平均。为了解决这一歧义，这些方法需要减去一张参考图，这要求使用空提示或更早的检查点进行第二次评估。但无条件模型没有空提示，且更早的检查点通常不可获得。我们证明，与对角线不同，雅可比行和无需参考图即可将记忆效应与局部平均区分开来。将JaRS与一种在早期去噪步骤中使用同一统计量的图像级检测分数相结合，即得到JaRS+。在Stable Diffusion……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出JaRS方法，利用去噪器雅可比矩阵的行和，无需参考图即可将扩散模型的记忆效应与局部平均区分开来，实现了无对比的记忆区域定位（JaRS+进一步结合图像级检测分数）。
en_tdlr: JaRS leverages Jacobian row sums to disentangle memorization from local averaging in diffusion models without requiring a reference map, enabling contrast-free localization of memorized regions (with JaRS+ adding an image-level detection score).
